proof_body:
by
  intro N m k hN hm
  have h10 : (1 : ℝ) < 10 := by norm_num
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hmr : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm1 : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) < 10 ^ k := by positivity
  have hk : Real.logb 10 ((10 : ℝ) ^ k) = (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one h10, mul_one]
  have e1 : Real.logb 10 ((m : ℝ) * 10 ^ k) = Real.logb 10 (m : ℝ) + k := by
    rw [Real.logb_mul hmr.ne' ht.ne', hk]
  have e2 : Real.logb 10 (((m : ℝ) + 1) * 10 ^ k) = Real.logb 10 ((m : ℝ) + 1) + k := by
    rw [Real.logb_mul hm1.ne' ht.ne', hk]
  rw [← Real.logb_le_logb h10 (mul_pos hmr ht) hNr, ← Real.logb_lt_logb_iff h10 hNr (mul_pos hm1 ht), e1, e2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ (N m k : ℕ), 1 ≤ N → 1 ≤ m → (((m : ℝ) * 10 ^ k ≤ (N : ℝ) ∧ (N : ℝ) < ((m : ℝ) + 1) * 10 ^ k) ↔ (Real.logb 10 (m : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb 10 (N : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) ∧ Real.logb 10 (N : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) < Real.logb 10 ((m : ℝ) + 1)))
